row.평가 축: 코딩(GPU 타일 커널 성능 평가·LLM 커널 생성)
row.정의: NVIDIA B200 GPU에서 Triton과 cuTile을 같은 연산 의미와 비슷한 구현 구조로 비교하는 통제형 벤치마크. 연산 45개(TritonBench 26, LeetGPU 19)로 이루어지며 연산마다 PyTorch 참조 구현, 검증된 Triton·cuTile 구현, dtype과 입력 크기 스윕(dtype당 입력 설정 20개), 기본·autotune 설정을 제공한다. 지표는 PyTorch 대비 속도 향상, 처리량, 유효 대역폭, roofline 활용도다. 별도의 LLM 코드 생성 트랙은 영어 연산 설명으로 최대 10회 반복 개선하며 correctness-gated speedup과 토큰 효율(TokenEfficiency@10)을 측정한다. 논문은 이 트랙에서 GPT-5.5와 Claude Opus 4.7을 평가했다.
row.대표 과제: 연산 설명과 PyTorch 참조로부터 Triton·cuTile 커널 생성(최대 10회 반복 개선, autotune 없음)
row.대표 예시·설명: vector_add 같은 연산의 영어 자연어 설명과 PyTorch 참조를 받아 Triton과 cuTile 커널을 생성하고, 검증 통과 여부와 roofline 활용도 피드백으로 다음 구현을 개선하는 과제(과제 설명, 실제 시험 문항 아님)
row.이용 시 유의사항: TileBench 자체의 데이터·코드 라이선스는 이번 검토에서 확인하지 못했다. 논문 부록 G는 TritonBench가 Apache-2.0이고 LeetGPU가 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0이며, LeetGPU 소스·테스트·수정된 문제문은 재배포하지 않고 독립 작성한 구현만 제공한다고 밝힌다. 원천 벤치마크의 약관은 별도로 확인해야 한다. 실행에는 NVIDIA B200 GPU, Triton 3.6.0, cuda-tile 1.3.0이 필요하며 결과는 단일 GPU·두 DSL에 한정된다.

english_copy.axis: Coding (GPU tile-kernel performance evaluation and LLM kernel generation)
english_copy.definition: A controlled benchmark that compares Triton and cuTile on an NVIDIA B200 GPU under matched operator semantics and comparable implementation structures. It has 45 operators (26 from TritonBench, 19 from LeetGPU). Each operator provides a PyTorch reference, verified Triton and cuTile implementations, dtype and input-size sweeps (20 input configurations per dtype), and default and autotuned configurations. Metrics are speedup over PyTorch, throughput, effective bandwidth and roofline utilization. A separate LLM code-generation track uses English operator descriptions with up to 10 refinement iterations and measures correctness-gated speedup and token efficiency (TokenEfficiency@10). The paper evaluates GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7 on this track.
english_copy.task: Generate Triton and cuTile kernels from an operator description and a PyTorch reference (up to 10 refinement iterations, no autotuning)
english_copy.example: Task description, not an actual test item: given the English natural-language description of an operator such as vector_add and its PyTorch reference, the model writes Triton and cuTile kernels and refines them using verification and roofline-utilization feedback.

screening.paper_title: TileBench: A Controlled Benchmark for Performance Evaluation and Bottleneck Diagnosis of Tile-Based Programming Models
screening.abstract: Tile-based programming models, such as Triton and cuTile, aim to simplify high-performance kernel development, but their practical performance, tuning behavior, and usability remain difficult to compare systematically. We present TileBench, a controlled benchmark for evaluating Triton and cuTile on NVIDIA B200 GPUs under matched operator semantics and comparable implementation structures. TileBench contains 45 operators covering diverse AI-kernel patterns and memory/computation behaviors. Each task provides a PyTorch reference, verified Triton and cuTile implementations, standardized data-types (dtype) and input-size sweeps, default and autotuned configurations, roofline-based metrics, and profiling-guided diagnosis. Our evaluation shows that performance gaps are workload-dependent: cuTile excels on a small cluster of Tensor-Core/TMA-friendly kernels, while Triton is stronger on many irregular, streaming, and bandwidth-bound operators. We further evaluate LLM-generated cuTile and Triton kernels and find that Triton is consistently more token-efficient than cuTile under the same iterative refinement protocol. TileBench is publicly available at https://github.com/Deep-Learning-Profiling-Tools/Tilebench.
